description: A digital producer must lock the final production package for a one-hour festival livestream fan Q&A, including the audience-question workflow, guest segment timing, sponsor message timing, and required production commitments.

shared_context.S1: The festival's live fan Q&A is scheduled to stream from 7:00 PM to 8:00 PM on the festival platform.
shared_context.S2: The current draft places the featured guest segment from 7:00 PM to 7:30 PM, followed by audience questions, with a sponsor message near the end.
shared_context.S3: Mara has final authority to lock the livestream production package.
shared_context.S4: The production team uses a routine preflight meeting before locking a livestream, during which technical, talent, and sponsorship leads report any confirmed constraints and the producer records the resulting changes.

PF1.text: Leon confirmed during today's platform latency test that audience questions must run through a moderated queue with a 30-second delay; direct audience-to-guest questions would not be safely controllable on this platform. He has not yet entered the result in the production brief.

PF2.text: Sofia confirmed with the featured guest's agent this morning that the guest is available only from 7:15 PM through 7:45 PM, inclusive, because of a separate appearance. She has not yet updated the shared run-of-show.

PF3.text: Darius reviewed the executed sponsor agreement today and confirmed that the sponsor message must begin at exactly 7:50 PM and run for exactly 2 minutes, followed by the sponsor's required verbal acknowledgment. The signed timing requirement is still awaiting entry in the sponsorship tracker.

acceptance_conditions: Audience questions must use a moderated queue with a 30-second delay.
The featured guest segment must run exactly from 7:15 PM through 7:45 PM.
The sponsor message must begin exactly at 7:50 PM and last exactly 2 minutes.
The sponsor acknowledgment must be included in the locked package.
The technical workflow, talent timing, and sponsorship timing must each be recorded as production commitments.

content_checks.C6: any(c['type'] == 'technical_workflow' and c['target'] == 'audience questions' for c in commitments)
content_checks.C7: any(c['type'] == 'talent_schedule' and c['target'] == 'featured guest' for c in commitments)
content_checks.C8: any(c['type'] == 'sponsor_compliance' and c['target'] == 'sponsor message' for c in commitments)

decisive_facts.why: The platform test changes the audience-question method from unrestricted live questions to a moderated queue with an exact 30-second delay and creates the technical workflow commitment.
The agent-confirmed availability changes the guest segment from the draft 7:00-7:30 PM period to exactly 7:15-7:45 PM and creates the talent schedule commitment.
The executed agreement changes the sponsor message to exactly 7:50 PM for exactly 2 minutes and creates the sponsor-compliance commitment, including the required acknowledgment.
